## Intro

Plot conditional effects from predictions in script "02-fit-sdms-conditional.qmd"

## Load packages & source functions

```{r load libraries}
#| message: false
#| warning: false

# Load libraries, install if needed
library(tidyverse)
library(readxl)
library(tidylog)
library(RCurl)
library(devtools)
library(patchwork)
library(viridis)
library(RColorBrewer)
library(here)
library(ggnewscale)
library(ggh4x)


devtools::source_url("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/maxlindmark/spatial-metabolic-index/main/R/functions/map-plot.R")
options(ggplot2.continuous.colour = "viridis")

pal_temp <- brewer.pal(n = 10, name = "Paired")[c(2, 6)]
pal_oxy <- brewer.pal(n = 10, name = "Paired")[c(8, 4)]

# Set path
home <- here::here()
```

## Read predictions

```{r}
preds <- read_csv(paste0(home, "/output/conditional_02_sdms.csv")) |> 
  filter(oxy > 3 & oxy < 9) |>
  filter(temp > 2 & temp < 14) |>
  separate(group, c("species", "life_stage"), sep = "_", remove = FALSE) |> 
  mutate(species = str_to_title(species),
         life_stage = str_to_title(life_stage)) |> 
  mutate(est_sc = exp(est)/max(exp(est)),
         .by = group)  # for plotting all together in heatmap

grid_preds <- read_csv(paste0(home, "/output/pred_grids_02_sdms.csv")) %>% 
  separate(group, c("species", "life_stage"), sep = "_", remove = FALSE) %>% 
  mutate(species = str_to_title(species),
         life_stage = str_to_title(life_stage))

cogs <- read_csv(paste0(home, "/output/cogs_02_sdms.csv")) |> 
  separate(group, c("species", "life_stage"), sep = "_", remove = FALSE) |> 
  mutate(species = str_to_title(species),
         life_stage = str_to_title(life_stage))
```

## Calculate weighted quantiles

```{r}
wq <- grid_preds |> 
  summarise("Median_oxy" = hutils::weighted_quantile(v = oxy, w = exp(est), p = 0.5),
            "10_oxy" = hutils::weighted_quantile(v = oxy, w = exp(est), p = 0.1),
            "25_oxy" = hutils::weighted_quantile(v = oxy, w = exp(est), p = 0.25),
            "75_oxy" = hutils::weighted_quantile(v = oxy, w = exp(est), p = 0.75),
            "90_oxy" = hutils::weighted_quantile(v = oxy, w = exp(est), p = 0.9),
            "Env_oxy" = median(oxy),
            
            "Median_temp" = hutils::weighted_quantile(v = temp, w = exp(est), p = 0.5),
            "10_temp" = hutils::weighted_quantile(v = temp, w = exp(est), p = 0.1),
            "25_temp" = hutils::weighted_quantile(v = temp, w = exp(est), p = 0.25),
            "75_temp" = hutils::weighted_quantile(v = temp, w = exp(est), p = 0.75),
            "90_temp" = hutils::weighted_quantile(v = temp, w = exp(est), p = 0.9),
            "Env_temp" = median(temp),
            .by = c(group, quarter)) |> 
  separate(group, c("species", "life_stage"), sep = "_", remove = FALSE) |> 
  mutate(species = str_to_title(species),
         life_stage = str_to_title(life_stage)) 

wq_annual <- grid_preds |> 
  summarise("Median_oxy" = hutils::weighted_quantile(v = oxy, w = exp(est), p = 0.5),
            "1st_oxy" = hutils::weighted_quantile(v = oxy, w = exp(est), p = 0.25),
            "3rd_oxy" = hutils::weighted_quantile(v = oxy, w = exp(est), p = 0.75),
            "Env_oxy" = median(oxy),
            
            "Median_temp" = hutils::weighted_quantile(v = temp, w = exp(est), p = 0.5),
            "1st_temp" = hutils::weighted_quantile(v = temp, w = exp(est), p = 0.25),
            "3rd_temp" = hutils::weighted_quantile(v = temp, w = exp(est), p = 0.75),
            "Env_temp" = median(temp),
            .by = c(group, year, quarter)) |> 
  separate(group, c("species", "life_stage"), sep = "_", remove = FALSE) |> 
  mutate(species = str_to_title(species),
         life_stage = str_to_title(life_stage)) 
```

## Plot conditional effects

```{r}
ggplot(preds, aes(temp, oxy, fill = est_sc)) + 
  geom_raster(alpha = 0.95) +
  geom_contour(aes(temp, oxy, z = est_sc), color = "grey95", bins = 15, size = 0.3, alpha = 0.5) +
  geom_point(data = wq, aes(Median_temp, Median_oxy, color = as.factor(quarter)), inherit.aes = FALSE) +
  geom_errorbar(data = wq, aes(Median_temp, Median_oxy, xmin = `25_temp`, xmax = `75_temp`, color = as.factor(quarter)), inherit.aes = FALSE,
                linewidth = 1.5, alpha = 0.5) +
  geom_errorbar(data = wq, aes(Median_temp, Median_oxy, ymin = `25_oxy`, ymax = `75_oxy`, color = as.factor(quarter)), inherit.aes = FALSE,
                linewidth = 1.5, alpha = 0.5) +
  # geom_errorbar(data = wq, aes(Median_temp, Median_oxy, xmin = `10_temp`, xmax = `90_temp`, color = as.factor(quarter)), inherit.aes = FALSE,
  #               alpha = 0.5) +
  # geom_errorbar(data = wq, aes(Median_temp, Median_oxy, ymin = `10_oxy`, ymax = `90_oxy`, color = as.factor(quarter)), inherit.aes = FALSE,
  #               alpha = 0.5) +
  scale_fill_viridis() +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("grey90", "tomato3")) +
  facet_wrap(~paste(species, life_stage), ncol = 3) +
  labs(y = "Oxygen (ml/L)", 
       x = "Temperature (°C)",
       color = "Quarter",
       fill = expression(paste("Scaled biomass density (kg/km"^2, ")"))) +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom", 
        legend.key.width = unit(1, "cm"),
        legend.title.position = "top") +
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(2.2, 13.5), 
                  ylim = c(3.3, 8.8),
                  expand = 0) +
  NULL
  
ggsave(paste0(home, "/figures/temp_oxy_conditional.pdf"), width = 17, height = 18, units = "cm")
```

```{r}
# Oxygen
wi_median_oxy <- preds |>
  left_join(wq |>
              filter(quarter == 4) |>
              dplyr::select(group, Median_oxy), by = "group") |>
  distinct(species, life_stage, Median_oxy) |> 
  mutate(group2 = paste(species, life_stage),
         group2 = factor(group2, 
                         levels = c("Cod Adult", "Cod Juvenile", "Flounder Adult", "Flounder Juvenile",
                                    "Plaice Adult", "Plaice Juvenile", "Turbot All", "Whiting All", "Dab All")))

wi_median_temp <- preds |>
  left_join(wq |>
              filter(quarter == 4) |>
              dplyr::select(group, Median_temp), by = "group") |>
  distinct(species, life_stage, Median_temp) |> 
  mutate(group2 = paste(species, life_stage),
         group2 = factor(group2, 
                         levels = c("Cod Adult", "Cod Juvenile", "Flounder Adult", "Flounder Juvenile",
                                    "Plaice Adult", "Plaice Juvenile", "Turbot All", "Whiting All", "Dab All")))

preds <- preds |> 
  mutate(group2 = paste(species, life_stage),
         group2 = factor(group2, 
                         levels = c("Cod Adult", "Cod Juvenile", "Flounder Adult", "Flounder Juvenile",
                                    "Plaice Adult", "Plaice Juvenile", "Turbot All", "Whiting All", "Dab All")))

ggplot() +
  facet_wrap(~ group2, ncol = 3, scales = "free_y") +
  geom_vline(data = wi_median_oxy, aes(xintercept = Median_oxy), 
             linetype = 2, alpha = 0.5, linewidth = 0.4) +
  geom_line(data = preds, aes(oxy, est, color = temp, group = temp)) +
  scale_color_viridis(option = "plasma") +
  labs(x = "Oxygen (ml/L)",
       y = expression(paste("Log biomass density (kg/km"^2, ")")),
       color = "Temperature (°C)") +
  theme(legend.position.inside = c(0.08, 0.57),
        legend.key.width = unit(0.4, "cm"),
        legend.key.height = unit(0.2, "cm")) +
  guides(color = guide_legend(position = "inside")) +
  NULL

ggsave(paste0(home, "/figures/supp/oxy_conditional.pdf"), width = 22, height = 16, units = "cm")

# Temperature
ggplot() +
  facet_wrap(~ group2, ncol = 3, scales = "free_y") +
  geom_vline(data = wi_median_temp, aes(xintercept = Median_temp), 
             linetype = 2, alpha = 0.5, linewidth = 0.4) +
  geom_line(data = preds, aes(temp, est, color = oxy, group = oxy)) +
  labs(x = "Temperature (°C)",
       y = expression(paste("Log biomass density (kg/km"^2, ")")),
       color = "Oxygen (ml/L)") +
  theme(legend.position.inside = c(0.07, 0.57),
        legend.key.width = unit(0.4, "cm"),
        legend.key.height = unit(0.2, "cm")) +
  guides(color = guide_legend(position = "inside")) +
  NULL

ggsave(paste0(home, "/figures/supp/temp_conditional.pdf"), width = 22, height = 16, units = "cm")
```

## Plot weighted quantiles over time

```{r}
t <- wq_annual |>
  pivot_longer(c("Median_oxy", `1st_oxy`, `3rd_oxy`, "Env_oxy", "Median_temp", `1st_temp`, `3rd_temp`, "Env_temp")) |>
  mutate(var = ifelse(grepl("oxy", name), "Oxygen", "Temperature"),
         type = ifelse(grepl("Env", name), "Environment", "Biomass-weighted")) |>
  separate(group, c("species", "life_stage"), sep = "_", remove = FALSE) |>
  mutate(species = str_to_title(species),
         life_stage = str_to_title(life_stage),
         group2 = paste(species, life_stage, sep = " ")) |>
  filter(name %in% c("Median_oxy", "Median_temp", "Env_oxy", "Env_temp"))
   
t_env <- t |>
  filter(type == "Environment" & group == "cod_adult") |>
  mutate(group2 = "Environment")
 
# Plot the slopes over time for group and quarter, compare to the environment slope.
s_slopes <- t |> filter(!type == "Environment") |>
  mutate(id = paste(group, var, quarter, sep = "_")) |> 
  ungroup() |> 
  dplyr::select(year, id, value)

t_slopes <- t_env |>
  mutate(id = paste("Environment", group2, var, quarter, sep = "_")) |> 
  dplyr::select(year, id, value)

slopes <- bind_rows(s_slopes, t_slopes)

# Calculate slopes over time
slopes2 <- slopes %>%
  split(.$id) |>
  purrr::map(~lm(value ~ year, data = .x)) |>
  purrr::map_df(broom::tidy, .id = 'Year') |>
  filter(term == "year") |> 
  mutate(upr = estimate + 1.96*std.error,
         lwr = estimate - 1.96*std.error,
         sig = ifelse(estimate > lwr & estimate < upr, "sig.", "not sig.")) |> 
  rename(id = Year, 
         year_slope = estimate) |> 
  dplyr::select(id, year_slope, sig, lwr, upr) |> 
  separate(id, into = c("species", "life_stage", "variable", "quarter"), remove = FALSE) |> 
  mutate(group3 = paste(str_to_title(species), str_to_title(life_stage)),
         x = "x") |> 
  mutate(quarter2 = ifelse(quarter == 1, "Quarter 1", "Quarter 4"))
  
vlines <- slopes2 |> 
  filter(species == "Environment")

slopes2 |> 
  filter(!species == "Environment") |> 
  distinct(group3)

order <- c("Cod Adult", "Cod Juvenile", "Flounder Adult", "Flounder Juvenile",
           "Plaice Adult", "Plaice Juvenile", "Turbot All", "Whiting All", "Dab All")  

#display.brewer.pal(name = "Paired", n = 12)
pal <- brewer.pal(n = 12, name = "Paired")[c(1:6, 8, 10, 12)]
#scales::show_col(pal)

slopes2 |> 
  filter(!species == "Environment") |> 
  mutate(group3 = factor(group3, levels = order)) |> 
  ggplot(aes(year_slope*10, group3, xmin = lwr*10, xmax = upr*10, color = group3)) + 
  geom_rect(data = vlines, aes(ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf, xmin = lwr*10, xmax = upr*10, fill = "Env. slope 95% CI"),
            inherit.aes = FALSE, alpha = 0.1) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = 3, color = "tomato2", alpha = 1) +
  geom_vline(data = vlines, aes(xintercept = year_slope*10, linetype = "Env. slope"), alpha = 0.7) +
  geom_point(size = 2, position = position_dodge(width = 0.4)) + 
  geom_errorbar(position = position_dodge(width = 0.4), width = 0) +
  facet_grid2(quarter2 ~ variable, scales = "free_x") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = "grey10") +
  scale_linetype_manual(values = 2) +
  scale_color_manual(values = pal) +
  labs(color = "", x = "Change in variable per decade", linetype = "", fill = "", y = "") +
  theme(legend.position.inside = c(0.37, 0.08),
        legend.spacing.y = unit(-0.85, "cm")) +
  guides(color = "none",
         linetype = guide_legend(position = "inside"),
         fill = guide_legend(position = "inside")) +
  NULL

ggsave(paste0(home, "/figures/decadal_slopes.pdf"), width = 17, height = 13, units = "cm")
```
